'''Lina Lascol''' was, alongside [[Kiri]], [[Lartan]], [[Mox Freedan]], and [[Ezak]], a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] were members of [[Wolf Clan]],<ref name="CSWE Wolf" /> one of several [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi clans]] for younglings who commenced their Jedi training.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] had living quarters and trained in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="CSWE Wolf" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE Temple">{{CSWECite|II|152|Jedi Temple}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lina Lascol was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE Wolf" />
